title: "{{< iconify boxicons article >}} Publications"

format:
  html:
    toc: false
    toc-title: "Quick navigation"

lightbox: true
#bibliography: my_publications.bib
#csl: apa-cv.csl
#nocite: '@*'
#link-citations: true
#reference-section-title: Publications

---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
library(RefManageR)

bib <- ReadBib("my_publications.bib", check = FALSE)

years <- sort(unique(unlist(bib$year)), decreasing = TRUE)

for (yr in years) {
  cat(paste0("\n### ", yr, "\n\n"))

  # Filter entries for this year
  bib_yr <- bib[year = yr]

  # Mark entries for inclusion
  NoCite(bib_yr, "*")

  # Capture output instead of printing it directly
  entry_text <- capture.output(
    PrintBibliography(
      bib_yr,
      .opts = list(
        check.entries = FALSE,
        max.names = 6,
        style = "html",
        bib.style = "authortitle",
        first.inits = TRUE,
        hyperlink = FALSE
      )
    )
  )

  # Bold your surname
  entry_text <- gsub(
    "Braadland",
    "**Braadland**",
    entry_text,
    fixed = TRUE
  )

  # Print the modified result
  cat(paste(entry_text, collapse = "\n"), "\n\n")
}


```
